method: Read-only source audit by evaluating existing build_site.py public-copy predicate, HTML/CSS/module link resolution, actual GLB JSON resource inspection, source hash comparisons and production frontend DOM/Skia gate tests. No browser or live remote deployment test was performed by this agent.

publication_predicate.exclusion_explanation: Only two web README files, four unreferenced preparation manifest JSON files and seven empty no-suffix platform-pack directory-marker files are excluded. No runtime request to the excluded manifests was found. All GLB models, OGG/WAV audio, atlas JSON and third-party notices required by current runtime are included.

dynamic_imports.coverage: All .js files below web are included by publication predicate.

licenses.scope: Three.js and cannon-es license notices, Kenney CC0 model/texture/audio pack notices and original generated-asset attributions are shipped; external reference games are linked and are not bundled upstream games.

external_dependencies.behavior: External original iframe and original code/source links require network; independent link is available. Original game is not a local licensed mirror.

Only remaining font network import discovered. Declared fallback Songti SC / SimSun / serif keeps language page readable without Google Fonts; identical typeface offline or in restrictive networks is not guaranteed.

room.old_auto_trigger: Restored session token triggers poll onStart/setActive and once per second while active. Fresh session waits for explicit create/join.
room.public_after_fix: Shows real room scene and rule description; no session-token restore, create/join/tasks/votes or polling on nonlocal host; controls disabled with clear no-backend notice. No fabricated participants or success.

relay.old_auto_trigger: postway restored receiveCode claims onStart; outgoing/ownerKey auto read/lookup; active records poll every 4 seconds. satchel and gavel do not use relay.
relay.public_after_fix: postway retains actual route drawing, role layout, undo and local restart; publish/receive/refresh/copy disabled; restored auto requests and polling skip public host. Low-level default request also rejects nonlocal hosts before fetch. Explicit relayRequest injection preserved for isolated tests.

checks: public room controls all disabled after start
public room with restored session emits zero loopback requests
public room does not invent participants or a new victory
public room scope is visible in shell and room log
local room still calls its original loopback endpoint
local room create flow remains available
public courier retains actual adjacent route editing
public courier undo removes an actual segment
public courier remains unpublished and incomplete
public restored carrier emits no automatic relay request
public restored author emits no automatic relay request
all public relay paths emit zero loopback requests
explicit injected relay still works on public hostname for isolated tests
public_production_gate_checks.scope: Production frontend factories through existing DOM/Skia adapters; no browser CSS acceptance or remote room backend.

regressions.scope: Existing production-factory and native-control adapters rerun successfully; backend services and saved real-user SQLite records were not changed.

overview_guide.usage: Use this exact image for project cover and prominent homepage summary entrance; do not generate a substitute.

recommendations: Publish existing asset allowlist unchanged for this project; current runtime assets and notices are complete. Do not add tooling servers, notes, SQLite databases, generation inputs or source manifests to the public artifact.
Describe room and asynchronous relay as local-service mechanisms, distinct from public static demos. Public GitHub Pages is not an internet multiplayer backend.
Keep existing historical and original-edition entrances and all 23 current/history HTML pages directly reachable; all were present during this audit.

Use 107 forms + 9 preserved legacy entries = 116 showcase entries, with 15 independent directions and 12 unstarted future notes as separate scopes. Do not add these numbers into one completed-game count.
State browser-local saves and non-migrating origin; local 127.0.0.1 saves are not automatically transferred to the GitHub Pages origin.
On deployment verify actual remote HTTP asset loads, 3D renderer startup and published gate messages; this source-level audit does not prove remote browser acceptance.
